plan.summary: This 4-week block fits an off-camp 12-week boxing plan with an endurance-first emphasis that still keeps enough strength and power work to support punching, posture, and durability. Week 1 establishes simple strength baselines on the main lifts so future loading is grounded, and the main training block starts in Week 2. Because sparring is a priority and session time is capped at 45 minutes with minimal home equipment, each session stays focused, low on fluff, and easy to recover from.

phaseOverview.label: Building
phaseOverview.focus: Build aerobic base, repeat-effort capacity, and simple full-body strength while keeping fatigue low enough for sparring.

phaseOverview.label: Intensifying
phaseOverview.focus: Progress the main endurance work and raise strength slightly without adding unnecessary soreness or interfering with boxing.

phaseOverview.label: Expressing
phaseOverview.focus: Keep the engine, sharpen repeatable power and speed, and carry the work into more sport-relevant outputs.

exercises.name: Countermovement Jump
exercises.notes: Jump crisp and land quietly. Stop if height drops off.

substitutionOptions.name: Squat Jump
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if you have limited ceiling space or want a simpler option.

exercises.name: Goblet Squat
exercises.notes: Warm up with a few easy sets, then build to one hard clean top set. Use the heaviest load you can control for 4-6 reps with solid depth and posture.

strengthAssessment.prompt: Warm up progressively, then work up to your hardest clean set of 4-6 reps. Log the load and reps so this gives us a baseline for future progression.

performanceTarget.prompt: Track your best clean top set load and reps.

substitutionOptions.name: Double Dumbbell Front Squat
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if your goblet setup gets awkward before your legs are challenged.

endurancePrescription.intensity: Easy to moderate pace. You should be able to breathe through the nose most of the time and speak in short sentences.
